fusions.name: Overdue Blow
fusions.desc: A long-delayed blow that deals 40 damage plus 6% of a boss or elite's maximum health, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tamping Down
fusions.desc: A short pounding that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Beaten Level
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once in one more blow on it for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
